title: SUVA: A Probabilistic Framework for Auditing LLMs with an Application to Social Preferences
abstract_600: Organizations are increasingly deploying large language models (LLMs) as customer service agents, decision aids, and semiautonomous agents. We develop State–Understanding–Value–Action (SUVA), a probabilistic auditing framework that turns an LLM’s response into structured evidence about how its decision was produced.
